description: Membuat gambar baru dari teks dan menyimpannya di komputer. Creates a new image from a text prompt with the Ezkielyna API and saves it locally. Returns the saved file path (use it in edit_image to keep editing). Every call is paid (see list_image_models for prices).

filename.description: Optional file name (no folder). The extension is set from the image type; existing files are never overwritten.

model.description: Image model id (default gpt-image-2.5). See list_image_models.

size.description: Optional size, e.g. 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536. Leave empty for the model default.

name: generate_image
title: Buat gambar / Generate image
